svg.title: How the safety stop ends, before and after the fix
svg.desc: Before: removal fails, an alert is raised and every check is refused. The daemon finishes the removal a moment later, but the alert stays anyway, and checks stay off until a person runs a command. After: the next check asks Docker. If Docker no longer lists the worker, the alert is cleared and the check runs. If Docker still lists the worker, or the answer fails or cannot be read, every check stays refused.
